Q. With reference to the implementation strategy and priority areas of Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin), consider the following statements: 1. The works under the scheme are tied to durable assets in five priority areas. 2. The funding mechanism shifts from normative allocation to a purely demand-based model with unpredictable allocations. 3. Planning is decentralized, originating from Viksit Gram Panchayat Plans (VGPPs) and led by Gram Sabhas. 4. For Union Territories without legislatures, the scheme is funded 100% by the Centre. Which of the above statements are correct? [A] Only 1 and 2 [B] Only 2 and 4 [C] Only 3 and 4 [D] Only 2, 3 and 4 [E] All of the above Answer: Option C
